error_coordinates_out_of_range: Error: Coordinates are out of range or incorrectly ordered (Lat before Lng required).
invalid_format: Invalid format. Please use 'lat,lng,lat,lng' or 'lat lng lat lng'.
world_scale_objects_skipped: Below 0.30 buildings and roads are too small to render, so only terrain and land cover are generated.
new_version_available: There's a new version available! Click here to see what's new.
update_modal_download_note: Download opens in your browser. Close Arnis before running the new version.
update_fetch_failed: Could not fetch the latest release information. Please check your internet connection or visit GitHub directly.
world_in_use: The selected world is currently in use
shapes_one_world: One World builds the rectangle around your shapes.
area_too_large: This area is very large and could exceed typical computing limits.
area_extreme: This area is extremely large and may be too big to generate successfully.
area_extensive: The area is quite extensive and may take significant time and resources.
select_area_prompt: Select an area on the map using the tools.
bbox_hint: Use the {tool} tool to draw an area
facade_mode_java_only: Photo panels are Java entities, so only the block facades are built on Bedrock and Luanti.
settings_subtitle: Configure how your Minecraft world should look and behave.
settings_section_world_desc: How the world plays when you first join it.
settings_section_generation_desc: Choose what gets built from the real-world map data.
settings_section_nature_desc: What lies below the surface and how trees are grown.
settings_section_facades_desc: Dress building walls with textures from photographs.
settings_section_map_desc: Fine-tune the selected area and the map you pick it on.
settings_section_application_desc: Where worlds are saved and how Arnis itself behaves.
settings_section_advanced_desc: Options for mods, compatibility and experiments. Most worlds never need them.
settings_section_about_desc: Arnis is free and open source. Thanks for using it!
gamemode_survival_desc: Gather, craft and survive with health and hunger.
gamemode_spectator_desc: Fly through everything without touching it.
mode_geo_terrain_desc: Buildings, roads and nature on real elevation.
mode_geo_only_desc: Buildings, roads and nature on flat ground.
mode_terrain_only_desc: Real elevation, water and nature without buildings or roads.
mode_blueprint_desc: Roads, water and nature, with buildings as outlines to build on.
facade_source_off_desc: Walls use the colours and materials from the map data.
facade_source_preset_desc: Bundled photos picked by building type. Java only.
facade_source_mapillary_desc: Real street photos of each building, where available.
world_time_desc: Time of day the world starts at.
world_type_desc: What lies past the edge of the area. Java only.
mob_spawning_desc: Let animals, and monsters too if you like, spawn on their own. Java and Bedrock.
map_item_desc: Start with a map of the whole area in your inventory. On Bedrock, the game's own starting map.
custom_world_name_desc: Name new worlds yourself instead of "Arnis World N". Java only.
overture_desc: Fills gaps in OpenStreetMap with satellite-detected footprints.
three_dmr_desc: Famous landmarks plus cars, boats, cranes and wind turbines.
interior_desc: Rooms, furniture and loot chests. Experimental and slower.
signage_desc: Readable street names, traffic signs and shop plates. Java only.
winter_desc: Snow on the ground, roofs and trees, frozen rivers and lakes.
post_apocalyptic_desc: Collapsed, overgrown buildings, cracked roads and no lights.
fillground_desc: Stone and ores below the surface for survival mining.
caves_desc: Caves, underground rivers and cave biomes under hills.
canopy_height_desc: Trees stand where real ones do, at roughly their height.
legacy_trees_desc: Simple procedural trees instead of detailed models.
max_tree_size_desc: Taller trees are swapped for a smaller species.
field_preset_desc: Each field grows its own crop instead of a mixed sheet.
mapillary_token_desc: Free from mapillary.com/developer. Stays on this computer.
facade_mode_desc: Hang the photos themselves, or match wall blocks to them.
facade_detail_desc: Higher detail is sharper but needs a modern graphics card.
facade_precompute_desc: Build the selected area's facades ahead of generating.
custom_bounding_box_desc: Type exact coordinates instead of drawing on the map.
world_scale_desc: 1.00 is real-world size. Smaller worlds generate faster.
height_multiplier_desc: 1.00 is real height. Higher values make hills and mountains taller.
rotation_angle_desc: Turn the area so streets line up with the block grid.
map_theme_desc: Style of the map you pick your area on.
custom_map_source_desc: Your own tile server, as a URL with {z}, {x} and {y}.
anonymous_crash_reports_desc: Send anonymous crash data to help improve Arnis.
discord_status_desc: Show Arnis as your activity on Discord.
java_save_path_desc: Folder new Java worlds are created in.
bedrock_save_path_desc: Folder the .mcworld file is saved to.
luanti_save_path_desc: Folder new Luanti worlds are created in.
clear_tile_cache_desc: Delete cached map tiles and facade textures.
disable_height_limit_desc: Raises the height limit when an area needs it. Not for Realms.
aws_only_elevation_desc: Older, coarser elevation source for when the default fails.
bake_lighting_desc: Precomputed light for LOD mods like Voxy. Slower.
voxy_lod_desc: Distant terrain renders on first join. Java only.
dh_lod_desc: Distant terrain renders on first join. Java only.
enable_luanti_desc: Adds Luanti (Mineclonia) as an output format. Experimental.
map_tool_area_desc: Drag over the map to choose what gets generated.
map_tool_add_hint: Hold Shift while drawing to add the shape to the selection.
map_tool_shape_desc: Click around the area to generate exactly that outline.
map_tool_shape_pieces_desc: A cell the shape touches is built in full.
map_tool_shape_one_world: One World builds the rectangle around the shape. Building in cells keeps the shape itself.
map_shape_start: Click to place the first corner.
map_shape_continue: Click to place the next corner.
map_shape_end: Click the first corner to close the shape.
map_shape_date_line: Draw the area on one side of the 180° meridian.
map_shape_too_far: Too far from the other areas: everything between them would be generated too. Make it a world of its own.
map_tool_rotation_desc: Draw a line along a street to line the world up with it.
map_tool_spawn_desc: Click where players start in the world.
map_tool_clear_desc: Removes the selected area and the spawn point.
map_balance_tip: Left fades the world tiles, right fades the cells. Double-click to reset.
map_tool_world_preview_desc: Lays the generated world over the map.
map_tool_terrain_desc: Shows the selected area's terrain in 3D.
map_tool_terrain_select: Select an area of up to 500 km² first.
map_tool_body_desc: Click to switch between Earth, the Moon and Mars.
preview3d_controls_hint: Drag to pan · right-drag to rotate and tilt
preview3d_buildings_too_large: Area too large for the buildings overlay (max 10 km²)
one_world_desc_off: Every area becomes a world of its own. Java only.
one_world_desc_on: Each area joins one growing world at its real position. Java only.
one_world_desc_live: One growing world that you play in Minecraft while Arnis generates the land around you. Java only.
one_world_foreign: Folder "{name}" exists but is not a One World
one_world_no_save_path: Set the Minecraft saves folder in Settings first
one_world_confirm_text: {count} chunks of this area already exist in the world. They are generated again, and anything built there in Minecraft is replaced.
settings_section_gameplay_desc: Extras that run from a data pack inside the world. Java only (Moving Vehicles also runs on Bedrock), not in One World mode. All off unless you turn them on.
pause_menu_desc: Travel, discoveries and credits from the pause menu.
discoveries_desc: Walk to real landmarks to unlock them as advancements.
zombie_outbreak_desc: Five nights of zombie waves through your streets, with a boss.
disasters_desc: A disaster every few minutes: floods, tornadoes, earthquakes and more.
body_gravity_desc: Real low gravity on Moon and Mars worlds.
moving_vehicles_desc: Cars, trains, ferries and ships that run your streets, tracks and water.
pedestrians_desc: People who walk your sidewalks and pedestrian streets.
discord_modal_text: Enjoying Arnis? Join our Discord to show off your worlds, get help and see what's coming next.
live_some_failed: some land could not be generated
live_version_desc: The server's version. Automatic takes the one you played last, unless the world needs a newer one.
live_view_distance_desc: How far the server sends the world. Further takes more memory and more land generated ahead of you.
live_eula_text: Live mode runs Mojang's Minecraft server on this computer, which needs you to accept the Minecraft End User License Agreement.
live_stage_start_area: Generating the land around the start: {done} of {total}
live_teleport_failed: The place you picked could not be generated
live_stage_stopping: Stopping the server and saving the world
live_stage_failed: Live mode stopped because of an error.
live_game_welcome: Arnis keeps generating the land as you explore.
live_game_building: Arnis is generating the land ahead
live_game_wall: Arnis is still generating this way
live_game_moved_back: That land is not ready yet
live_game_teleport_wait: Arnis is generating the place you picked. You will be moved there when it is ready.
live_game_teleport_failed: Arnis could not generate the place you picked.
advanced_meld_features_desc: Extra settings for large worlds and finer control. Off, Arnis behaves as before. Ported from the Meld project.
meld_workers_desc: Build a One World in cells, several at a time.
meld_ram_budget_desc: How much memory a run may use, in MB.
region_download_fallback: Region Download is not available for this selection, so Arnis used the default source.
meld_origin_tip: LAT,LON for the origin of a One World this run creates, instead of the centre of the selection. One World only.
advanced_meld_features_tip: Shows the Scale settings here and extra settings in Generation, Terrain & Nature, Map & Input and World. Turning it off hides them and sends none of them. Experimental.
meld_workers_tip: Splits a One World selection into cells of up to 4 × 4 regions and builds several at once, each in its own process. Auto picks 2 to 6 from free RAM and cores. Generating the same area again resumes it. One World only.
meld_recommended_tip: Fastest in the Nov 2026 benchmark on this kind of PC
plan_single: Small area: built in one run.
meld_ram_budget_tip: Sizes parallel work to this much memory instead of the free RAM measured, so several runs can share a machine. Empty measures free RAM.
meld_threads_tip: Left empty, it uses 90% of the cores. A job in cells splits it between the cells.
world_name_edit_one_world: Choose the One World to extend or create
meld_snap_desc: How the selection meets the cell grid.
meld_snap_tip: Off builds the selection as drawn. Cover grows it to whole cells, Fit shrinks it to the whole cells inside, Merge keeps its edges but folds a strip thinner than a quarter region into its neighbour. Parallel cells only.
meld_margin_desc: A ring of regions around the selection, from 0 to 4.
meld_margin_tip: Regions of 512 × 512 blocks added on every side of the selection, after snapping. Parallel cells only.
meld_piece_size_desc: Regions per side of each cell.
meld_piece_size_tip: Largest cell, in regions per side. Auto mixes 8 × 8, 4 × 4 and 2 × 2 cells, as large as fit the selection and the memory. Parallel cells only.
meld_piece_order_tip: Which cells are built first. Cell numbers stay the same, so a retry still names the same cells. Parallel cells only.
meld_skip_built_desc: Build only what the world is missing.
meld_skip_built_tip: Leaves out the cells whose every chunk is already in the world, say from an earlier job over part of this one. Off rebuilds them. Parallel cells only.
meld_stitch_map_desc: One map item over the whole job.
meld_stitch_map_tip: Once every cell is built, redraws the map item in the hotbar over all of them. Off, it shows the first cell only. Needs the map item. Parallel cells only.
meld_stretch_desc: Show the stretch of a One World selection.
meld_stretch_tip: How much the map is stretched at this latitude against the One World's origin: the ground is wider (+) or narrower (−) than it is tall. Shows a line in the plan, and the 5% and 10% lines on the map. One World only.
plan_state_room: Room to grow: you can build here later
legend_title: What the lines on the map mean
legend_drawing: Your selection while you draw it
legend_shape_rect: The rectangle One World builds around your shapes
legend_shape: The shape you drew; a cell it touches is built in full
legend_stretch_5: Past this line the map is stretched 5% against real distances
legend_stretch_10: Past this line the stretch is 10%; start a new world instead
area_outline_needs_pieces: The outline only applies to a build in cells; built in one go, the whole box is generated.
meld_use_pieces: Use Advanced features to build it in cells
plan_confirm_warn: This build takes a long time and uses most of the CPU and memory until it ends. Leave other heavy work for later and check there is enough free disk space.
plan_confirm_overlap: {n} cells overlap land already built and will be rebuilt.
map_tool_cells_desc: Click a cell or drag a box. Shift or Ctrl adds. Right-click for actions. Esc clears.
cell_none: No action fits all of these cells.
cell_head_why: The first cell builds alone and cannot be paused or cancelled.
cell_remove_confirm: Remove the selected cells ({n}) from the world? This cannot be undone.
cell_rebuild_confirm: Rebuild the selected cells ({n})? Their land is removed first.
